title: Phone send waits for dictation to finish, and plays sound cues for sent, Assistant replying, and reply done

fields.why: TJ asked mid-thread; separate phone feature, this session is long

text: TJ: send too fast cuts off his last words; wait for voice processing to stop before sending. Add 3 short sounds: sent, Assistant responding, reply done. Native Kotlin: mobile/android (Dictation.kt speech, MainActivity.kt UI, Link.kt relay). Laptop end mobile/bridge (bridge.mjs, lib.mjs; findAssistant reads state.json working/done). Ship: mobile/ship_android.sh --build; restart bridge via launchctl kickstart -k gui/UID/com.genlock.phone-bridge. Other uncommitted work is in mobile/: commit by path.

fields.user_said: yes commitand pysh and start on that new phone work

text: Send while dictating waits for the recognizer's final result (or a 3s cap, then uses the last partial) and sends the full text, last words included; Stop keeps them too
Phone plays a short distinct sound when a message is sent
Phone plays a distinct sound once when the Assistant starts on the message (bridge 'started' on the [phone] prompt in the transcript, or state going busy)
Phone plays a distinct sound when the reply arrives, before it is read aloud
APK builds and is shipped; bridge restarted with the change
TJ hears the cues and his last words arrive on the laptop
check: manual:TJ dictates and sends on the phone

evidence: Dictation.stop(then) keeps closing=true after stopListening, accepts onPartial/onSegmentResults/onResults while closing, finish() on onResults/onEndOfSegmentedSession/onError or 3000ms giveUp, appends lastPartial if no final; TalkScreen.send() sends the text from the callback; APK built (classes3.dex has finishWithinMs)
Cues.kt: sent = 660->990Hz two notes; Link plays Cues.sent() on the laptop's ack of a pending message (delivered, not just tapped); Cues class in classes3.dex of 0.1.450564

bridge TranscriptFollower.onPhone fires on '[phone] ' user line (shape checked against real Assistant transcript a8c34440...jsonl), bridge sends {kind:'started'}; phone cueStarted() once per message on 'started' or state->busy; npm test 10/10 pass incl new follower.test.mjs
MainActivity onReply: Cues.done() then TTS posted after Cues.DONE_MS=360ms so speech does not talk over it
ship_android.sh --build -> Shipped version 0.1.450564, 16512843 bytes, checked online; launchctl kickstart bridge -> pid 71573, log 21:25:25 connected to relay

text: Built+shipped 0.1.450564 (dictation waits for final words up to 3s; cues sent/started/done), bridge emits 'started', restarted. Open: TJ installs and tries it (req 6). Not committed.

evidence: TJ on phone 0.1.450564 dictated a long message and hit Send; it reached Tally whole, ending with his words: 'All right let's give this a shot Can you actually tell the gen lock session that this is working'. Sounds were not mentioned separately.

answers.observed: TJ's long dictated message reached Tally whole on 0.1.450564; bridge npm test 10/10; Cues and finishWithinMs present in classes3.dex
answers.cause: Measured by fix: old onResults dropped results once wanted=false and send fired at stop; new path waits for final result. Not instrumented on device which path (final vs 3s partial fallback) carried his last words
answers.absence: Sounds unconfirmed: TJ did not mention hearing the sent/started/done cues; not absent, just unreported
answers.assumption: Mine: the recognizer delivers a final result after stopListening; if it does not, the 3s fallback sends the last partial, which can still drop a word said in the final instant
answers.falsify: A dictated message whose last words are missing on the laptop, or no sound on send/start/reply
